data.one_liner: Sharp looking Flutter applications at any pixel scaling factor.
data.what_it_does: Ensures Flutter applications render sharply on systems with non-integral pixel scaling (like Windows at 150%) by snapping sizes, paddings, and widget positions to physical pixel boundaries. It provides extension methods and drop-in widget replacements for basic and layout widgets.
use_when: Building desktop applications, especially for Windows where non-integral scaling factors are common
Fixing blurry borders, lines, or text caused by fractional device pixel ratios
avoid_when: Using heavy arbitrary rotation or scale transforms throughout the UI layout
strengths: Solves blurry rendering issues on non-integral pixel scaling factors
Provides drop-in replacements for standard Flutter widgets via custom imports
Includes extension methods for easily snapping numeric and layout values
weaknesses: Requires using custom imports for standard widgets to fully automate pixel snapping
Arbitrary scale and rotation transforms can interfere with accurate pixel snapping
